name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: US strikes Iranian sites near Hormuz; Iran sends response as blockade continues
state: A US official said the US struck Iranian surface-to-air missile sites near Hormuz on 2 Nov; Iranian media reported blasts on Qeshm and Hengam islands and near Bandar Abbas (AP). Iran's chief negotiator said a response was sent to the US on 3 Nov, and Iran says it can reopen the strait in two days if the blockade ends. A third US carrier is heading to the region.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states; flights and shipping can be disrupted at short notice.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states; Hormuz closed = Alert

sources.title: AP — US strikes Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz
CBS News — Iran war live updates

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
